confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge for a July 2026 peak-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the more reliable; hotel and hostel rates are least certain because they swing with season and events. Cocktail and wine were set from their typical price relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from RBA search-result summaries rather than a direct page read, so confirm the 15 Oct 2026 figure on the RBA page after its 4pm update.
comparable_city_reasoning: Judgment-based comparison to central Lisbon tourist districts and other Iberian and Southern European capitals with similar summer demand (e.g., Porto, Madrid); no live data or specific listings used.
